title: Rubric-Based AES with LLM Ensembles: Scoring of Student Responses in Critical Online Reasoning Using Ensembles of LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2611.21422v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Grading student responses is costly and time-consuming. Moreover, human annotators are prone to bias, fatigue, and rater drift, which further limits grading reliability. Various methods have been employed to develop automated essay scoring (AES) systems to reduce these costs and address bias-related issues. These methods range from early text-feature-based systems to current machine-learning and transformer-based models. Specifically, large language models (LLMs) offer the potential to streamline the development of AES systems. However, they are subject to well-known limitations, such as hallucinations and prompt sensitivity. This creates a need to explore the potential of a mixed-methods approach that leverages the synergies among individual LLMs through ensemble formation. We evaluate the potential of ensembles of LLMs to match human-rater agreement when grading student responses in economics and medical education across 103 criteria.

translated_title: 基于评分量规的大语言模型集成自动作文评分：使用大语言模型集成对学生在批判性在线推理中的回答进行评分
translated_abstract: 对学生的回答进行评分成本高昂且耗时。此外，人工评分者容易受到偏见、疲劳和评分漂移的影响，这进一步限制了评分的可靠性。为降低这些成本并解决与偏见相关的问题，人们已采用多种方法开发自动作文评分（AES）系统，这些方法从早期基于文本特征的系统发展到当前的机器学习和基于Transformer的模型。特别是，大语言模型（LLM）为简化AES系统的开发提供了潜力。然而，它们也存在众所周知的局限性，例如幻觉和对提示词的敏感性。这就需要探索一种混合方法的潜力，即通过构建集成来利用各个LLM之间的协同作用。我们在经济学和医学教育领域，针对103项评分标准，评估了大语言模型集成在给学生回答评分时达到与人类评分者一致性的潜力。
tldr: 该研究提出基于评分量规、通过构建大语言模型集成来对学生在经济学和医学教育中的批判性在线推理回答进行自动评分，并验证了LLM集成有望达到与人类评分者相当的一致性水平。
en_tdlr: This study proposes rubric-based automated essay scoring using LLM ensembles and demonstrates their potential to match human-rater agreement when grading student responses in critical online reasoning across 103 criteria in economics and medical education.
